=== Jay Support Letter.pdf ===
November 16, 2026

Re: PUC Docket No. 59475

Dear Chairman Gleeson and Commissioners:

I support John B. Bradley’s Motion for Conditional Disclosure on the Record and
Conditional Recusal of Chairman Thomas J. Gleeson (docket item 6670).

The POLITICO reporting and Robert Black’s Outlook calendar entries raise serious
concerns for me. The calendar identi es a December 16, 2025 “Transmission
Roundtable” (Transmission…not “Data Center” and not “Interconnection”), and lists
Chairman Gleeson among con rmed stakeholders alongside representatives of utility
companies, ERCOT, and the Governor’s o ce.

The transmission-speci c subject of this closed-door meeting and the listing of the
Chairman alongside representatives of utilities seeking transmission approvals cause
me to question his impartiality in the related CCN proceedings. I want a clear public
accounting of whether he attended and what was discussed.

Based on these circumstances, I support Chairman Gleeson’s recusal from further
substantive participation in Docket No. 59475, including deliberations and votes.

Scott J Brown
Landowner in Uvalde and Kinney Counties, Texas

 November 16,2026

Re: PUC Docket No. 59475

Dear Chairman Gleeson and Commissioners:

I support John B. Bradley's Motion for Conditional Disclosure on the Record and
Conditional Recusal of Chairman Thomas J. Gleeson (docket item 6670).

The POLITICO reporting and Robert Black's Outlook calendar entries raise serious
concerns for me. The calendar identifies a December 16, 2025 "Transmission
Roundtable" (Transmission...not "Data Center" and not "Interconnection"), and lists
Chairman Gleeson among confirmed stakeholders alongside representatives of utility
companies, ERCOT, and the Governor's office.

The transmission-specific subject of this closed-door meeting and the listing of the
Chairman alongside representatives of utilities seeking transmission approvals cause
me to question his impartiality in the related CCN proceedings. I want a clear public
accounting of whether he attended and what was discussed.
Based on these circumstances, I support Chairman Gleeson's recusal from further
substantive participation in Docket No. 59475, including deliberations and votes.

Scott J Brown
Landowner in Uvalde and Kinney Counties, Texas
